name: core.openwop.workflows.agent-knowledge
description: WF-KB-1 — the ADR 0038 §B auto-ingest workflow, migrated off the in-tree `registerWorkflow({...})` pin site in features/agent-knowledge/feature.ts. A trigger (webhook/email/form, RFC 0099) ignites this chain; the single `feature.agent-knowledge.nodes.ingest` node writes an UNTRUSTED, cited KB document into a collection bound to the agent. Registered chain-backed under the ORIGINAL id `feature.agent-knowledge.auto-ingest`, so the seeded demo trigger subscription keeps resolving and replay is unchanged — and it is now gallery-visible and builder-editable like every other chain.
